sloka: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणो राम चोदितः ।आचचक्षे महात्मानम् रामम् दशरथात्मजम् ॥४-४-५॥
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇo rāma coditaḥ ।ācacakṣe mahātmānam rāmam daśarathātmajam ॥4-4-5॥

translations.english: Having listened to Hanuman, and urged by Rama, Lakshmana told him about the great Rama, son of Dasaratha.
